codeFindings.claim: Roots are declared, never inferred, and 'the outer wall never guesses' — a declared root that resolves to nothing raises unknown-root (module-NAME roots with zero decl members raise root-vocabulary-mismatch/V3).
codeFindings.reality: _resolve_roots' module-ID branch (a declared n_<16hex> id whose node kind is 'module') expands to the module's decl members but does NOT raise when that member list is empty — it records 'module-id-expanded' with members [] and contributes nothing. An all-module-id root set therefore yields declared=[] and analyze_session proceeds as if roots were UNDECLARED (gapAnalysis.undeclared=true) even though roots were declared, while the equivalent module-NAME spelling raises UnknownRootDeclared. Untested path; no suite fixture declares roots by module id.
